composition.story: Seven samples sit sorted on one feature, each labelled A or B. The tree tries every midpoint between neighbours as a cut. For each cut it scores the left and right groups by weighted Gini impurity. Stepping through all six cuts shows why 3.5 wins: it leaves the purest children.

aha.observation: Cut 3.5 wins: its children are purest overall, weighted Gini 0.214, lower than all five other midpoints, the nearest being 5.5 at 0.229.

variants.label: Threshold search on feature x (7 samples, 4 A and 3 B)

states.label: Sort
states.sentence: Sort the samples by x. Before any split, the whole set of 7 has Gini impurity 0.490.
states.why: Sorting makes every possible split a cut between neighbours.

states.label: Candidates
states.sentence: Candidate cuts are midpoints between neighbouring x values: 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5 and 6.5.
states.why: Only these cuts change which samples go left or right.

states.label: Cut 1.5
states.sentence: Cut 1.5 sends only x=1 left. The right child is still mixed, so the gain is small.

states.label: Cut 2.5
states.sentence: Cut 2.5 puts two pure A samples left. The right child still holds A and B in a 2:3 mix.
states.why: A pure left child contributes zero impurity.

states.label: Cut 3.5
states.sentence: Cut 3.5 keeps three pure A samples left. The right child is mostly B, with one stray A.
states.why: Lower weighted impurity than 2.5, so this cut becomes the new best.

states.label: Cut 4.5
states.sentence: Cut 4.5 pulls B at x=4 into the left child, which becomes mixed. Impurity rises sharply.
states.why: Both children are now impure, so the weighted score worsens.

states.label: Cut 5.5
states.sentence: Cut 5.5 makes the right child pure B, but the left child holds the one B beside four A.
states.why: Close to 3.5, yet slightly worse: 0.229 against 0.214.

states.label: Cut 6.5
states.sentence: Cut 6.5 leaves only x=7 on the right. The left child is mixed with 4 A and 2 B.
states.why: A tiny pure child cannot rescue a large mixed one.

states.label: Pick best
states.sentence: The tree picks the cut with the lowest weighted Gini: x ≤ 3.5, with 0.214 against the parent's 0.490.
states.why: Best split = argmin over cuts of weighted child impurity.
